data: Is the value of the blue line at depth 4 lower than that of the green line at the same depth?

The question asks whether the value of the blue line at depth 4 is lower than that of the green line at the same depth. From the analysis of the figure:

1. The blue line represents the accuracy for the Restaurant category.
2. The green line represents the accuracy for the Laptop category.
3. At depth 4, the blue line (Restaurant) is above the green line (Laptop).

Therefore, the value of the blue line at depth 4 is not lower than that of the green line at the same depth. It is higher.
